# Code of conduct

Personal Media Tracker welcomes constructive participation from people of every
background and experience level.

Be respectful, specific, and patient. Critique ideas and code rather than people. Do not
harass, threaten, discriminate against, or publish another person's private information.
Do not upload real watch histories, credentials, databases, logs, or exports when
reporting a problem; use a minimal synthetic example instead.

Maintainers may edit or remove contributions that violate these expectations and may
temporarily or permanently restrict participation for repeated or serious violations.
Report conduct concerns privately through the repository's security-reporting channel.
Maintainers will protect the reporter's privacy as far as reasonably possible.

This policy applies in repository issues, pull requests, discussions, and other project
spaces.
